name: 舌の一貫性解析
algorithm: Tongue Consistency — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes tongue rendering and consistency for deepfake detection:

1. **Tongue検出**: The tongue is detected when visible during speech and expressions (tongue protrusions, licking lips, certain phoneme articulations like /l/, /t/, /d/). Tongue shape, color, and surface texture are characterized per frame.

2. **TongueAnatomy検証**: Natural tongues have specific anatomical features: dorsal surface texture (papillae), central groove (median sulcus), smooth ventral surface, characteristic pink-red coloration. The method checks anatomical correctness. AI-generated tongues may show: incorrect color, missing texture, wrong shape, or physically impossible configurations.

3. **Tongue-音素Coordination**: Tongue position should correspond to articulated phonemes — visible tongue tip for /l/, /th/, tongue retraction for /k/, /g/. The method checks whether tongue visibility and position correlate correctly with detected speech sounds. Deepfakes may show tongue positions inconsistent with the audio.

4. **時間的Tongue安定性**: When the tongue is not actively moving (resting in closed mouth, sustained position during speech holds), its appearance should remain stable between frames. The method tracks tongue consistency — AI generation may produce flickering tongue texture or shape changes during supposedly static tongue positions.

5. **Tongue-Teeth-唇Interaction**: During speech, tongue, teeth, and lips interact in coordinated, anatomically constrained ways. The method checks whether these interactions are physically plausible. Deepfakes may produce impossible interaction states — tongue passing through teeth or occupying impossible positions relative to the oral cavity.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through tongue consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
